name: cli-classifier
description: cli-classifier is the single public skill identity for typed classifier judgments. It routes Jev requests to the cli-jev transport through mode-registry.json and hub-router.json. The hub holds cli-jev today, and future classifiers can join as new modes with their own packets.
trigger_examples: use jev choice to pick a queue
ask jev for a probability that this plan ships on time
score these three levels with jev
run a batch of typed questions through jev
what does the cli-classifier hub do
